name: Cushi
overview: Cushi is a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Zephaniah the prophet, as recorded in Zephaniah 1:1. There is no information about his tribal affiliation or additional personal notes. His significance is closely tied to his role in the lineage of the prophet Zephaniah.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Cushi' appears once in Scripture and is presented as a proper name without a provided meaning or divine origin. Therefore, the name is simply recognized as the personal name of this individual without further etymological insight.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Cushi as the father of Zephaniah, the prophet, and also mentions Gedaliah as his son. These relationships establish Cushi as a patriarch within this prophetic family line.
scriptureSignificance: Cushi's primary importance in the biblical narrative comes from his role as the father of Zephaniah, who is a significant prophetic figure. Through this connection, Cushi is part of the heritage that brings forth the prophetic ministry recorded in the Book of Zephaniah. Although little else is recorded about him, his mention anchors the prophetic lineage in historical context.
